A hood with a dangling pompom rests over her shoulders, and fur cuffs, a bow headband, teardrop sleeves, and round shoe ornaments complete the festive full length coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rapunzel Butterfly Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel greets a butterfly in a garden in this printable coloring page, smiling down at its large open wings while holding both hands gently beneath it. A thick braid hangs beside her striped puff sleeve, and scalloped neckline trim, small flowers, scattered leaves, and low garden plants provide details across the princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cinderella Enchanted Castle Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinderella poses before an enchanted castle in this printable coloring page, turning toward the viewer with a smile beneath swept bangs and a neatly arranged high bun. Decorated drop earrings and a slim choker complement her folded off shoulder neckline, while pointed towers and narrow windows fill the background of the princess portrait coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ariel Mermaid Ocean Wave Coloring Page
pages.description: Mermaid Ariel sits beneath a curling ocean wave in this printable coloring page, looking upward with a smile as her long hair streams behind her shoulders. The foamy wave crest arches over the rock, while a shell top, folded waist fins, broad tail, and long striped flukes define the princess on the seaside coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Jasmine Dreamy Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Jasmine dreams in this printable coloring page, resting her cheek in one hand and looking upward with a soft smile beneath a broad sweep of hair. A plain headband, large hoop earring, small ring, and gathered shoulder sleeve add details to the close portrait, with her segmented ponytail behind the princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Aurora Paris Eiffel Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Aurora visits Paris in this printable coloring page, posing with one hand near her neckline while the Eiffel Tower rises behind her long hair and small crown. Domes, rooftops, narrow windows, and distant buildings fill the city background, contrasting with the bold outlines of her angular gown on the travel themed princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cinderella Palace Stairs Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinderella stands on palace stairs in this printable coloring page, smiling as she lifts both sides of her broad gown beside an ornate rising stone railing. Round finials top the posts, and delicate scrolls decorate the balustrade, while a high bun, pendant, long gloves, and softly ruffled hem complete the princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cinderella Tiana Best Friends Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinderella and Tiana pose as best friends in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a large heart outline with Tiana holding flowers and Cinderella carrying a slipper. Tiny hearts, pointed sparkles, circles, floral accents, jeweled earrings, and Tiana's leaf shaped tiara surround the pair's formal gowns on the detailed princess friendship coloring sheet.

pages.title: Belle Holding Rose Coloring Page
pages.description: Belle holds a rose in this printable coloring page, supporting its long leafy stem with both gloved hands while tilting her smiling face beneath swept hair. The flower's layered petals contrast with her broad neckline folds, round clasps, pointed bodice, and gathered skirt panels on a simple princess portrait coloring sheet with open background space.

pages.title: Classic Snow White Standing Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow White stands in a classic princess pose in this printable coloring page, smiling with her hands clasped low before her long skirt and feet close together. A bow headband, short rounded hair, high collar, teardrop puff sleeves, pointed bodice, and small shoe bows define the familiar costume on the full length coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Ariel Elegant Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Ariel smiles in an elegant portrait in this printable coloring page, lifting both hands toward her neckline as long straight hair spreads behind her shoulders. A star shaped hair clip, triangular drop earrings, teardrop puff sleeve decorations, and a pointed bodice provide small details around her cheerful face on the clear princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Belle Village Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Belle appears in her village outfit in this printable coloring page, smiling with one hand near her chest inside a room lined with simple wooden wall panels. A tied ponytail, collared blouse, gathered sleeves, and plain apron define her clothes, while shelf bottles and a handled pot supply background details on the princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Belle Enchanted Rose Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Belle admires an enchanted rose in this printable coloring page, holding it near her softly smiling face while her other gloved hand rests across her skirt. Small roses decorate the gathered gown, and scalloped neckline trim, round earrings, a high bun, and long curls add elegant details to the closely framed princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mulan Graceful Traditional Gown Coloring Page
pages.description: Mulan wears a graceful traditional gown in this printable coloring page, extending both hands gently beside long hanging sleeves while her loose hair drifts over one shoulder. A broad wrapped sash, layered neckline, rounded hip panels, small hair ornament, and flowing train create the clear costume shapes across the full length princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rapunzel Flynn Rider Hug Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel and Flynn Rider hug in this printable coloring page, closing their eyes with gentle smiles as they wrap both arms around each other beside a stone arch. Rapunzel's long hair and laced dress contrast with Flynn's belted vest, while a wall shelf and small bowl add simple room details to the couple coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cinderella Prince Charming Romance Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinderella and Prince Charming share a romantic embrace in this printable coloring page, leaning close with their eyes closed as Cinderella rests her hand against his chest. Leafy branches frame the couple, and the prince's tasseled shoulder pieces, high collar, broad belt, and Cinderella's gathered skirt supply details on the royal romance coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rapunzel Elsa Best Friends Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel and Elsa pose as best friends in this printable coloring page, standing close with Rapunzel's arm wrapped gently across Elsa's shoulders inside a broad circular frame. Rapunzel's loose hair and puff sleeve contrast with Elsa's swept fringe, thick side braid, and high collar, creating two distinct princess portraits on the friendship coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cinderella Rapunzel Friends Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinderella and Rapunzel meet as friends in this printable coloring page, smiling at each other with Cinderella holding a wand and Rapunzel carrying a frying pan. A large Roman numeral clock, hanging lantern, leafy tree, and tower frame their contrasting gowns, with Rapunzel's laced bodice and Cinderella's rounded hip panels on the detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow White Winter Cape Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow White wears a winter cape in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath her bow headband as thick fur trim crosses her shoulders and chest below. Holly leaves, berry clusters, and small round dots frame the portrait, while teardrop sleeve decorations and the fitted dress add familiar princess details to the festive coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ariel Holiday Undersea Coloring Page
pages.description: Ariel celebrates an undersea holiday in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath a holly hair ornament while round baubles and strings of small lights hang above her. Coral branches rise behind her flowing hair, and rounded puff sleeves and a scale patterned bodice bring contrasting textures to the close festive princess portrait coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Jasmine Magic Lamp Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Jasmine presents a magic lamp in this printable coloring page, holding its handle and base with both hands as a thin ribbon of smoke curls upward. Her oval headband jewel, decorated drop earrings, plain necklace, and swept hair frame the close portrait, with the lamp's long spout crossing the bottom of the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Jasmine Classic Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Jasmine strikes a classic pose in this printable coloring page, touching her chin with one hand while her other arm extends gently to the side. Her long hair curls behind jeweled waist and neckline clasps, and loose trousers, large hoop earrings, a jeweled headband, and pointed slippers complete the full body princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Princess Ariel with Tiara Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Ariel poses with a tiara in this printable coloring page, sitting with one knee raised beneath a sweeping gown as her hair curls around her face. An ornate crown, large earrings, gathered puff sleeves, long gloves, layered skirt edges, and pointed heels provide fine details across the elegant seated princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow White with Bird Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow White holds a little bird in this printable coloring page, smiling at its lifted wings as it balances on one raised finger beside her face. Her short rounded hair, bow headband, standing collar, teardrop puff sleeves, and fitted bodice complete the simple portrait, with open space surrounding the princess and bird on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Mulan Traditional Kimono Coloring Page
pages.description: Mulan poses in a traditional kimono in this printable coloring page, smiling forward with long flowing hair and teardrop earrings above a wide bow tied sash. Small flowers decorate the broad sleeves, while larger blossoms, leafy stems, tiny hearts, and curved neckline layers surround the princess portrait on this floral themed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ariel Little Mermaid on Rock Coloring Page
pages.description: Ariel from The Little Mermaid leans on a rock in this printable coloring page, smiling with her mouth open as her long hair streams sideways behind her. Large splashes rise around the broad foreground rock, while a shell top, folded waist fins, and bright wide eyes create the central details on the seaside princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cinderella Portrait Coloring Page
pages.description: Cinderella smiles in this printable coloring page, shown in a close portrait with a high bun, swept bangs, and a loose curl beside one teardrop earring. A plain headband and narrow choker frame her face, and broad folded shoulder panels lead into a simple fitted bodice on the clear, uncluttered princess portrait coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow White Ballerina Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow White dances as a ballerina in this printable coloring page, lifting both arms into a rounded pose above her head beneath tall leafy forest trees. A short flared skirt with a ruffled hem, teardrop puff sleeves, tiny neckline bow, pointed bodice, and bow headband define her ballet costume on the woodland princess coloring sheet.

pages.title: Garden Princess Drawing A Picture In A Storybook Village Coloring Page
pages.description: A garden princess draws a picture in a storybook village in this printable coloring page, working in a large sketchbook on her lap. A flower crown and densely patterned gown echo the surrounding blooms, while mushroom houses, a stone bridge, and winding paths fill the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Cute Princess Waving To A Friend In A Crystal Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: A cute princess waves to a friend in a crystal palace in this printable coloring page, meeting another crowned princess before the central doorway. Heart and star emblems mark their bodices, with layered skirts, faceted towers, radiating circles, and simple clouds surrounding the pair on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Forest Princess Playing With A Kitten At An Enchanted Castle Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: A forest princess plays with a kitten at an enchanted castle gate in this printable coloring page, resting the cat on her spotted skirt. Flowers and leaves decorate her hair and the arch above her, with curling gate bars, castle towers, and small floating circles on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Elf Princess Smiling Happily in an Autumn Park Coloring Page
pages.description: An elf princess smiles happily in an autumn park in this printable coloring page, holding the edges of her skirt with her eyes closed. Her pointed ears, jeweled headband, long cape, and wavy hair sit among fallen leaves, acorns, rounded trees, and a small bench on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Rapunzel Princess Sailing Gently on a Castle Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Rapunzel sails gently beside a castle bridge in this printable coloring page, sitting in a small wooden boat with a paddle across her lap. Her long hair trails over the stern, while stone blocks, flagged towers, two birds, clouds, and rippling water surround the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Princess Walking on a Rainbow in a Summer Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A snow princess walks on a rainbow in a summer garden in this printable coloring page, wearing a crown and fluffy-trimmed cape. Her flowing hair and long skirt sit above the rainbow's broad bands, surrounded by butterflies, flowers, clouds, and a large sun on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Animal Friend Princess Holding an Umbrella in a Sparkling Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: An animal friend princess holds an umbrella in a sparkling palace in this printable coloring page, standing beneath its bow and scalloped edges. Her pointed ears, fluffy tail, heart tiara, and layered gown sit before a curved staircase, draped columns, chandelier, and towers on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ariel Princess Posing Proudly Near a Royal Carriage Coloring Page
pages.description: Ariel poses proudly beside a royal carriage in this printable coloring page, placing both hands on her hips beneath a small crown. Her long hair and full gown stand beside the domed carriage, with tied curtains, spoked wheels, a lantern, birds, and clouds on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Summer Princess Running Happily on a Glowing Rainbow Coloring Page
pages.description: A summer princess runs happily on a glowing rainbow in this printable coloring page, stretching both arms as her hair and short skirt sweep behind her. A small crown and hair flower join broad rainbow bands, rounded clouds, star-shaped sparkles, and a simple sun on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Summer Princess Opening a Treasure Chest in a Royal Library Coloring Page
pages.description: A summer princess opens a treasure chest in a royal library in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside coins, beads, and a jeweled crown. A second crown rests on a cushioned stool, with bookshelves, stacked books, an arched window, and tied curtain behind her on the coloring sheet.
